Facebook (FB) Shareholder American Money Management Has Decreased Its Holding as Share Value Declined; Foundation Capital Has Lowered Lendingclub (LC) Position as Valuation Rose
June 4, 2018 - By Nellie Frank
American Money Management Llc decreased its stake in Facebook (FB) by 50.14% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. American Money Management Llc sold 8,764 shares as the company’s stock declined 0.01% with the market. The institutional investor held 8,716 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $1.39 million, down from 17,480 at the end of the previous reported quarter. American Money Management Llc who had been investing in Facebook for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $557.33B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.75% or $1.45 during the last trading session, reaching $192.54. About 6.19M shares traded. Facebook, Inc. (NASDAQ:FB) has risen 21.69% since June 4, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.12% the S&P500.
Foundation Capital Llc decreased its stake in Lendingclub Corporation (LC) by 30.06% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. The institutional investor held 11.63M shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $40.71M, down from 16.63 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Foundation Capital Llc who had been investing in Lendingclub Corporation for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $1.39B market cap company.
